- [Anthropic accused Chinese AI labs](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/23/anthropic-accuses-chinese-ai-labs-of-mining-claude-as-us-debates-ai-chip-exports/) of distillation attacks on its Claude model, highlighting risks to US AI leadership and the importance of export controls on advanced chips for national security.
- [Google’s Cloud AI advanced](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/23/googles-cloud-ai-lead-on-the-three-frontiers-of-model-capability/) on intelligence, latency, and cost-efficiency via Vertex AI, strengthening its position in scalable, enterprise-ready AI and influencing future investment in AI infrastructure.
